note: Forbidden: a route from a Customer or Peer, by an RS from an RS-client, or by an RS-client from an RS verified other than by the upstream algorithm. TestASPAUpstreamAppliesToCustomerPeerAndRSRoutes asserts configuredASPAMode == aspaUpstream for local roles provider, peer, rs and rs-client (one per listed case) and that the down-ramp path is Invalid under each, red if any maps to downstream; local role customer maps to aspaDownstream and verifies the same path Valid.
